rv.q: This is a fantastic play about the complexities of life, reminding us that human beings are not and never will be linear.
Overall, Relative Motion is an intelligent, unique and entertaining piece of theatre that combines science, humour and psychological drama in a rather unusual and thought-provoking way.
This is an accomplished play that raises questions while presenting an assured script and characters.
There is clear potential in the idea, with some powerful and unsettling moments, but at this point the production does not quite sustain the momentum needed to bring all the elements together.
